## Description {#details}

<p>A wrapper class for inspecting calls to intrinsic functions.</p>


<p>This allows the standard isa/dyncast/cast functionality to work with calls to intrinsic functions.</p>


<p>Definition at line 48 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/ir/intrinsicinst-h">IntrinsicInst.h</a>.</p>
